title: Obstructive Sleep Apnea Syndrome in Glaucoma
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to determine if plasma matrix-metalloproteinase activity can predict glaucoma in patients with OSAS and if the level of plasma matrix-metalloproteinase activity will decrease after one month of nCPAP-treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* OSAS planned begin of a nCPAP treatment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current malignancy
* Oral steroids
